summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K confirming the closing of a previously disclosed private placement to Target Capital 1, LLC. The investor purchased a US$10,000,000 unsecured convertible promissory note for a US$8,000,000 subscription price plus common warrants for up to 29,122,679 Class A Ordinary Shares (4,853,780 post a six-for-one consolidation effected October 7, 2026). Tranches funded July 24, September 1, and October 8/13, 2026. Resale registration on Form F-1 was declared effective October 5, 2026. Watch dilution and resale overhang.
